independent_feedback_mutant.reason: Independently advancing unreset replicas retain distinct offsets; write/read ownership split corrupts first qualified data.

mechanism: All copies receive identical combinational next-state function of one canonical counter vector. Arbitrary power-up copies converge at edge1. Writes of first required din begin edge2, hence output valid at edgeD=N+2 without a reset or extra edge.
limitations: Ring mechanism only. No production source edit or first-use/valid/occupied-reset comparator; mapping must preserve common D and coherent write/read address ownership. No simulation initialization relied upon.
